use: Original key art for website, Unity naming screen and README
prompt: Create an original high-end illustrated key art background for CIBIO, a fictional satirical Brazilian pixel-art action RPG. Use the attached existing title art ONLY as character/environment/style reference: a brown-skinned Brazilian young adult worker, dense short dark curly hair, worn yellow football T-shirt with green neck/sleeve trim, blue jeans and work shoes, in a Brazilian colonial working-class village. NEW SHOT: cinematic close three-quarter portrait from upper thighs up on the RIGHT 60 percent of a very wide 16:9 composition, face clearly visible, fierce exhausted anger and determination, clenched jaw, lowered eyebrows, clenched fist at hip with restrained warm golden energy wrapping the knuckles, grounded and human rather than superhero costume. The LEFT 40 percent must stay very dark and quiet, textured charcoal wall for UI text overlays. Background on right: layered plaster wall, torn generic unpaid invoices with tiny illegible marks (no readable text), closed small shop, cobbled street, weathered green shutters, hints of tropical vegetation. Dramatic burnt-amber rim light and muted red dusk, deep charcoal and warm paper tones, worn saturated Brazil yellow, green accents. Detailed painterly pixel clusters, crisp textured edges, refined indie RPG cover quality, entirely consistent with the supplied game's hand-painted pixel setting. Anger at debt and bureaucracy, no gore, no real people, no real party logos, no emblems, no crowds, no weapons. Strong carefully composed face, plausible anatomy, five fingers, no low-poly geometry, no 3D render, no generic neon sparks, no interface, no lettering, no typography, no watermark. Make this polished dramatic art that can anchor both a website and a character naming screen. Opaque background.
